title: Download a model
intro: Downloads a model from the Ollama library onto every AI node (or one node).

steps.label: Model name
steps.help: e.g. llama3.2, qwen2.5:7b, gemma3:4b (see ollama.com/library). Small models (1-4B) suit Raspberry Pis.

steps.label: Only on this node (leave empty for every AI node)
